thread.title: Wall Street Analyst Warns Don’t ‘Rush into Buying Apple Today’

title: Wall Street Analyst Warns Don’t ‘Rush into Buying Apple Today’
text: Wall Street Analyst Warns Don’t ‘Rush into Buying Apple Today’ More Wall Street Analyst Warns Don't 'Rush into Buying Apple Today'## AppleThis week, tech giant Apple’s (AAPL) stock seem to be on a path of recovery after losing 5.1% last week. Today at 12:56 PM ET, the stock was trading on a positive note with 1.4% gains for the day. However, one analyst warned investors against rushing into buying Apple stock. Let’s take a closer look.## Bernstein’s views on AppleAnalyst Toni Sacconaghi from Bernstein told CNBC today, “I don’t think there’s any need to rush into buying Apple today.” Basing his argument on relative valuation, the analyst said, “Apple is not that inexpensive.”He also observed, “The magnitude of the decline in iPhones was bigger than anyone anticipated. There were lots of warning signs from the supply chain that the iPhones would be weak, but the initial reaction is- that was worse than we thought. We think iPhone revenues will be down about 14% year-over-year in the quarter.”Many notable analysts from reputed research firms—including Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, UBS, and HSBC—cut their estimates for Apple over the last couple of months, even before Apple cut its guidance last week.In the fourth quarter of 2018, Apple (AAPL), Amazon (AMZN), Microsoft (MSFT), Alphabet (GOOG), NVIDIA (NVDA), Facebook (FB), and Netflix (NFLX) lost 30.1%, 25.0%, 11.2%, 13.4%, 52.5%, 20.3%, and 28.5%, respectively. The S&P 500 Index (SPY) and NASDAQ Composite Index fell 14.0% and 17.5%, respectively, last quarter.
